problem_statement:
Escaped characters in .env files don't work properly

Description

When using escaped characters in .env files, they are not being properly decoded. This affects several common use cases like escaped quotes and newlines.

For example, when I have a .env file with the following content:
```
a="b\\nc"
a="b\"c"
a='b\'c'
```

The values are not properly decoded. When trying to access these values, I get an IndexError.

Reproduction:

```python
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Create a .env file with:
# a="b\\nc"
# a="b\"c"
# a='b\'c'

load_dotenv()
# Accessing these values will cause an error
```

This is particularly problematic when working with values that need to contain quotes or special characters. The parser seems to be incorrectly handling the escape sequences in the strings.
